answer: Under cohort-quota waiting-list admission, each identity joins the onyx network only by claiming a slot from a rolling global lottery whose per-epoch quota equals Q₀/2^t, where t counts consecutive high-admission epochs, so flooding itself compresses future supply. An honest newcomer needing one slot faces the same lottery but only once, and every confirmed identity emits a liveness signal that resets t toward shale-like stability, making patient honest entry cheap while mass attackers pay an exponentially compounding price.
